intended_object: An equivalence between limit-cone structures: a binary bicone is a limit cone iff the associated general bicone (indexed by the walking pair) is a limit cone. Inferred from the docstring and name.
explanation: This is API glue between two Mathlib encodings of the same notion (BinaryBicone vs Bicone over WalkingPair). It is a `def` only because `IsLimit` is data, so the "iff" has to be an Equiv. It is built by transporting along the cone isomorphism `Cone.ext (Iso.refl _)` via `IsLimit.equivIsoLimit`. Mathematically it is a lemma, not an object. It matches its docstring and holds in full generality (any category with zero morphisms), so there is no correctness or generality problem. It is a technical device with no mathematical counterpart of its own.
